description: Test suite for verifying correct forwarding of custom headers in Bedrock rerank API calls, including both synchronous and asynchronous tests. It ensures that headers passed via parameters are correctly included in API requests, especially when proxying headers from clients, handling merging of multiple header sources, and confirming proper integration with the 'litellm' library.

classes.description: Synchronous HTTP request handler class used for API interactions in tests.

classes.description: Asynchronous HTTP request handler class used for API interactions in async tests.

methods.description: Test that verifies correct forwarding of custom headers in synchronous Bedrock rerank API calls.

methods.name: test_bedrock_rerank_header_forwarding_async(model)
methods.description: Async test verifying correct forwarding of custom headers in asynchronous Bedrock rerank API calls.

methods.name: test_bedrock_rerank_extra_headers_and_headers_merge()
methods.description: Test ensuring headers from proxy (kwargs) and explicitly passed extra_headers are correctly merged and forwarded.
